description: This file defines the Java class OrCriteriaImpl, which implements the Criteria interface to represent a logical OR operation on multiple criteria within a query framework. It includes methods for processing visitor patterns, equality checks, and hash code generation.

classes.name: OrCriteriaImpl
classes.description: Implementation of Criteria representing a logical OR over multiple criteria.

methods.name: OrCriteriaImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OrCriteriaImpl with a list of criteria, ensuring the list is not null.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a CriteriaVisitor and applies the visitor to each child criterion, returning the aggregated result.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is equal to this OrCriteriaImpl instance based on the criterias list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for this instance, incorporating the criterias list.
